version.author: ReaLab
version.changelog: Stable-channel distribution of the v0.14.0-dev.7 macOS ARM64 build (same binary; not rebuilt).

version.author: ReaLab
version.changelog: Rebuilt with matching stable version 0.14.2 and a Developer ID Application signature. Secure timestamp and hardened runtime verified; checksums and provenance are attached to the release. macOS 15.0+ Apple Silicon (ARM64). Signed only; not notarized.

version.author: ReaLab
version.changelog: Discover readable names for new approved repositories before Scripts/Effects paths are created. Preserve installed ownership; no automatic old-folder migration or cleanup. Reject equivalent Mac case/Unicode namespace collisions and revoke stale subscriptions on partial discovery. All nine native test groups passed on Mac and Linux; test full installation in isolated REAPER resources. macOS 15.0+ Apple Silicon (ARM64). Developer ID-signed; not notarized.

version.author: ReaLab
version.changelog: Temporary classroom recovery: retrieve one-line HTTPS configuration pointer from ReaPackLab-Config/bootstrap-url.txt. Ignore malformed local url.txt on standard macOS installations without requiring privileged file changes. Preserve strict INI validation, managed repository policy, and the current Setup 0.1.1 installer. macOS 15.0+ Apple Silicon (ARM64). Developer ID-signed; not notarized.
